# Performance_Prediction_Model

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A machine-learning or statistical model that forecasts UAV link quality (e.g., throughput, latency) from features like altitude, location, and network type, trained on field-collected data. Enables proactive topology reconfiguration in iNEST, allowing in-network neuromorphic controllers to anticipate link degradation and pre-emptively reroute data.
